SQS moves repeatedly failed
messages to the DLQ.
Notifications need their own
production retry policy.

div.div:
Order + outbox commit atomically; the stream-triggered publisher filters outbox records.
SNS + SQS deliver at least once: both Lambda consumers must be idempotent.
Illustrative design: authentication, IAM, observability and deployment details omitted.
